While "apparent pauses" are noted on cardiac auscultation, this is an objective finding of the examiner and does not equate to the patient reporting subjective palpitations (Option 2); furthermore, palpitations are a specific symptom distinct from observed arrhythmias. There is no mention of dyspnea at rest, with exercise, or lying down (Option 3). The patient has fever with chills ("febbre con brivido"), but diaphoresis (sweating) is not explicitly stated as present; chills are distinct from diaphoresis (Option 4). There is no mention of sudden death (Option 5).
